title: Preserve Civ7 SDK Runtime Neutrality
forbids: Civ7 map runtime, official API, adapter, ambient type, or Swooper execution imports in the authoring SDK
why: The SDK authors portable mod data and files. Civ7 map-script execution belongs to the deployable map application, not an SDK subpath.
remediate: Move map runtime behavior to its qualified mod application and keep the SDK limited to runtime-neutral authoring capabilities.
